This work product covers the entire change initiative lifecycle but will be iterated to include further detail of business readiness and adoption activities as they become more defined:

Business Engagement

This section details the activities and tasks involved with executing the business change strategy via stakeholder engagement. It describes how the approach will become operable with planned steps, resources, milestones and timelines, etc. aimed to engage and manage stakeholders throughout the change process.

The engagement section of the plan provides a structured way to effectively engage, mobilize and monitor stakeholders. It outlines activities to motivate stakeholders that need to change as well as those that are charged with managing the deployment of the new solution. The plan identifies tactics to build stakeholders commitment and/or compliance to the change initiative.

In general, this section describes:

  • Desired and current commitment levels of key stakeholders
  • Actions to achieve desired frequency and type of engagement for each stakeholder group
  • Identified interrelationships and dependencies between stakeholders
  • Method for updating and refining the stakeholder management plan as the project progresses
  • The engagement plan is updated during the change life cycle to reflect evolving stakeholder management requirements

This section defines the work activity, resources, work products and deliverables needed to execute the business change approach with the aim to secure the appropriate amount of buy-in or compliance to the changes that will result from implementing a change initiative. The plan is used as a reference and refreshed throughout the program lifecycle.

Business Readiness

This section details the activities and tasks involved with executing the Business readiness Approach. It describes how the approach will become operable with planned steps, resources, milestones and timelines, etc. aimed to prepare the business for change. It identifies all activities and tasks needed to effectively work with the business to plan and manage people related changes.

Business Adoption Plan

The business adoption section specifies the actions that define, monitor and report metrics about post implementation stabilization and adoption of the business solution. This section's content supports the conduct and monitoring of business adoption during and after implementation.

To define work activity, resources, work products and deliverables needed to fulfill the overall change strategy; outlines how to consult, engage, mobilize and manage people through the change process.

Deployment timing will be more difficult if a business readiness plan is not used to onboard business representatives; this section enables the project team to more accurately plan readiness activity.

This work product has sections for the following:

  • Business engagement
    • Definition of how engagement activities and tasks will be conducted throughout the appropriate phases of the project lifecycle
    • Stakeholder identification and prioritization
    • Cadence for engagement
    • Considerations of business, geography or functional engagement
  • Business readiness
    • Definition of how readiness activities and tasks will be conducted throughout the appropriate phases of the project lifecycle
    • Outline of the mechanics of defining readiness criteria including readiness categories, core and business specific criteria
    • Identification of the number and level of business leaders and representatives needed from impacted functional areas
    • Considerations for how business leaders and representatives can ready for business change
    • Identification of status reporting periods
  • Business adoption
    • Definition of how adoption and support activities and tasks will be conducted throughout the appropriate phases of the project lifecycle
    • Identification of the number and level of business leaders and representatives needed from impacted functional areas to support the business change
    • Considerations for how business leaders and representatives can adopt and sustain business change
